Description: Robert VI de Brus, future Earl of Carrick and father of Scotland's legendary liberator King Robert I the Bruce, is the eldest son of Robert V 'The Competitor' and Isabella de Clare. Sixteen years of age, tall, powerfully built, and possessing piercing gray eyes, he radiates the formidable martial spirit of his chivalric heritage. Uniting the royal Dunkeld bloodline of Huntingdon with the fighting prowess of William Marshal and the Earls of Gloucester, young Robert exhibits extraordinary mastery of heavy arms. Across the tilting grounds of Lochmaben Castle and the Solway marshes, he charges upon war destriers with terrifying momentum, wielding broadsword and lance with veteran precision. Scottish annals commend his early border reconnaissance along the Solway, where at age sixteen he routed a band of lawless Marcher cattle raiders with decisive courage. Fiery, ambitious, and deeply imbued with crusader zeal, Robert prepares himself to inherit the mantle of House Bruce. Carrick charters attest to young Robert's rigorous drills of heavy cavalry across the wild Galloway hillsides; possessed of boundless chivalric vigor and unyielding honor, his daring leadership during border incursions has won him the passionate loyalty of hard-bitten Annandale spearmen and Norman retainers alike.
Motivations: Hone cavalry shock tactics and heavy swordplay to become an invincible champion on tournament and battlefield.
Stand as his father's paramount military lieutenant, prepared to lead the Bruce host in defense of their royal claims.
Values: Values raw martial courage, chivalric rectitude, and fierce dynastic ambition above cautious complacency.
Believes true royalty is forged in the heat of battle through unrelenting valor and unbreakable honor.
Fears: Fears failing to uphold the legendary martial standard set by his great-grandfather William Marshal.
Dreads diplomatic compromises by timid regents depriving House Bruce of its rightful crown.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with ringing martial fervor and bold chivalric confidence, concise, fiery, and inspiring.
